hero.headline: Software delivery is the disciplined stabilization of useful form under uncertainty.
hero.support: A Boundary-First engineering method for discovering the domain, tightening uncertainty, exposing invariants and responsibility, and letting working artifacts correct the plan before ambiguity hardens into architecture.

sections.heading: Discovery is progressive closure
sections.body: Backlogs, refinement, prototypes, and working increments should reduce uncertainty rather than merely create more descriptions of work.

sections.heading: Certainty must meet execution
sections.body: A task becomes implementation-ready when the business/domain cone of certainty intersects the executable cone at the right granularity.

sections.heading: Build a delivery skeleton
sections.body: Establish the path from domain uncertainty to delivered artifact early enough that integration, deployment, ownership, and environmental blockers become visible.

sections.heading: Working software is a witness
sections.body: The artifact is allowed to falsify assumptions, expose missing distinctions, and reshape the plan.

sections.heading: Closure is stronger than completion
sections.body: Done means the relevant domain condition is represented, executable, observable, deliverable, and repairable—not merely that a ticket changed state.
